title: vepris gossweileri
intro: Vepris gossweileri, commonly known as the Yellow Vepris or White Vepris, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used in West and Central Africa for its health benefits. The plant has been found to have antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions, including skin infections and fever. The bioactive constituents of Vepris gossweileri include limonoids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
